items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: So Clarence and Ernie Fields, the other band leader was, they were fashionable throughout the whole southwest, from Kansas City to Dallas to New Mexico.

ctx.x: I love it that years later you’re playing B flat 7 with Pharoah Sanders.

Well it wasn’t too long after this episode with Jimmy “Cry Cry” that what’s his name, it jumped off my tongue, I ended up in the jazz club in Tulsa, Oklahoma, which was called Clarence Love’s Lounge. Clarence Love was one of the big band leaders throughout the 20s and early 30s that traveled throughout the southwest along with another local big band headed by — jumped right out of my head now — but it’ll come back to me — but he apparently had reasonable — well Tulsa is not too far north of Houston, not too far…
